propositions.name: first_appearance_new_beings
propositions.statement: The first appearance of new beings on this earth is the great fact, the mystery of mysteries, toward which the Galapagos facts bring the observer near.
propositions.quote: we seem to be brought somewhat near to that great fact—that mystery of mysteries—the first appearance of new beings on this earth

propositions.name: aboriginal_creations_exist
propositions.statement: Most organic productions of the archipelago are aboriginal creations found nowhere else.
propositions.quote: Most of the organic productions are aboriginal creations, found nowhere else

propositions.name: climate_food_soil_produce_variety
propositions.statement: New and peculiar climate, food, and soil can produce a variety of a species from an imported stock.
propositions.quote: this rat is merely a variety, produced by the new and peculiar climate, food, and soil, to which it has been subjected

propositions.name: species_taken_and_modified
propositions.statement: From an original paucity of birds one species may have been taken and modified for different ends.
propositions.quote: one might really fancy that from an original paucity of birds in this archipelago, one species had been taken and modified for different ends

propositions.name: buzzard_induced_to_office
propositions.statement: A bird originally a buzzard may have been induced here to undertake the office of the carrion-feeding Polybori.
propositions.quote: it might be fancied that a bird originally a buzzard, had been induced here to undertake the office of the carrion-feeding Polybori of the American continent

propositions.name: islands_geologically_recent_seabed
propositions.statement: Within a geologically recent period the unbroken ocean spread over the sites now occupied by the islands.
propositions.quote: within a period, geologically recent, the unbroken ocean was here spread out

propositions.name: created_on_american_types
propositions.statement: The aboriginal inhabitants were created on American types of organization though placed physically far from America.
propositions.quote: why were they created on American types of organization? It is probable that the islands of the Cape de Verd group resemble

propositions.name: similar_conditions_unlike_inhabitants
propositions.statement: Islands with closely similar physical conditions bear totally unlike aboriginal inhabitants, so physical conditions do not determine the type.
propositions.quote: the islands of the Cape de Verd group resemble, in all their physical conditions, far more closely the Galapagos Islands than these latter physically resemble the coast of America; yet the aboriginal inhabitants of the two groups are totally unlike

propositions.name: fixed_hereditary_instinct_refuge
propositions.statement: A fixed and hereditary instinct directs the marine lizard to the shore as its place of safety.
propositions.quote: urged by a fixed and hereditary instinct that the shore is its place of safety, whatever the emergency may be, it there takes refuge

propositions.name: wildness_becomes_hereditary
propositions.statement: Wildness toward man is not acquired by individual birds in a short time but becomes hereditary over successive generations.
propositions.quote: it is not acquired by individual birds in a short time, even when much persecuted; but that in the course of successive generations it becomes hereditary

propositions.name: domesticated_habits_hereditary
propositions.statement: In domesticated animals new mental habits or instincts are commonly acquired and rendered hereditary.
propositions.quote: With domesticated animals we are accustomed to see new mental habits or instincts acquired and rendered hereditary

propositions.name: islands_never_united
propositions.statement: The profound ocean depth and recent volcanic origin make it highly unlikely the islands were ever united to the continent.
propositions.quote: the profound depth of the ocean between the islands, and their apparently recent (in a geological sense) volcanic origin, render it highly unlikely that they were ever united

propositions.name: currents_separate_islands
propositions.statement: Strong sea currents separate the islands so far as transportal by the sea is concerned.
propositions.quote: very strong currents of the sea running in a westerly and W.N.W. direction must separate, as far as transportal by the sea is concerned, the southern islands from the northern ones

propositions.name: creative_force_on_islands
propositions.statement: An astonishing amount of creative force has been displayed on these small, barren, and rocky islands.
propositions.quote: one is astonished at the amount of creative force, if such an expression may be used, displayed on these small, barren, and rocky islands

propositions.name: different_islands_different_beings
propositions.statement: The different islands to a considerable extent are inhabited by a different set of beings.
propositions.quote: the different islands to a considerable extent are inhabited by a different set of beings

propositions.name: representative_species_analogous_role
propositions.statement: Representative species of the same genera occupy analogous situations, filling the same place in the natural economy of the archipelago.
propositions.quote: these species having the same general habits, occupying analogous situations, and obviously filling the same place in the natural economy of this archipelago

propositions.name: halting_place_new_forms
propositions.statement: The Galapagos Archipelago is a halting-place where many new forms have been created and where two conchological provinces have each sent colonists.
propositions.quote: at the Galapagos Archipelago we have a halting-place, where many new forms have been created

propositions.name: species_may_be_only_races
propositions.statement: Some representative species, at least among tortoises and birds, may hereafter prove to be only well-marked races.
propositions.quote: It may be suspected that some of these representative species, at least in the case of the tortoise and of some of the birds, may hereafter prove to be only well-marked races

propositions.name: aboriginal_inferred_from_distribution
propositions.statement: Occurrence on all or nearly all the islands, including small waterless ones, is grounds to infer aboriginal status.
propositions.quote: There can be little doubt that this tortoise is an aboriginal inhabitant of the Galapagos; for it is found on all, or nearly all, the islands, even on some of the smaller ones where there is no water

propositions.name: transportation_in_vessel
propositions.statement: A native mouse could plausibly have been transported in a vessel, since analogous instances have been observed.
propositions.quote: for I have seen, in a most unfrequented part of the Pampas, a native mouse living in the roof of a newly-built hovel, and therefore its transportation in a vessel is not improbable

propositions.name: eggs_shells_transported_salt_water
propositions.statement: Calcareous-shelled lizard eggs can be transported through salt-water more easily than the slimy spawn of frogs, explaining the absence of frogs on oceanic islands.
propositions.quote: by the greater facility with which the eggs of lizards, protected by calcareous shells, might be transported through salt-water, than could the slimy spawn of frogs

propositions.name: aquatic_forms_less_peculiar
propositions.statement: Aquatic forms, marine or fresh-water, are less peculiar at any given point of the earth's surface than terrestrial forms of the same classes.
propositions.quote: this law of aquatic forms, whether marine or fresh-water, being less peculiar at any given point of the earth's surface than the terrestrial forms of the same classes

propositions.name: marked_relationship_to_america
propositions.statement: Aboriginal inhabitants show a marked relationship with those of America despite 500-600 miles of open ocean.
propositions.quote: yet all show a marked relationship with those of America, though separated from that continent by an open space of ocean, between 500 and 600 miles in width

propositions.name: archipelago_zoologically_america
propositions.statement: The archipelago, though in the Pacific Ocean, is zoologically part of America.
propositions.quote: we see that this archipelago, though standing in the Pacific Ocean, is zoologically part of America

propositions.name: satellite_receiving_stray_colonists
propositions.statement: The archipelago is a satellite attached to America whence it has derived a few stray colonists.
propositions.quote: The archipelago is a little world within itself, or rather a satellite attached to America, whence it has derived a few stray colonists

propositions.name: islands_formed_volcanic_rocks
propositions.statement: All the islands are formed of volcanic rocks, with only trifling exceptions.
propositions.quote: They are all formed of volcanic rocks; a few fragments of granite curiously glazed and altered by the heat, can hardly be considered as an exception

propositions.name: created_in_center_and_dispersed
propositions.statement: The terrestrial Amblyrhynchus appears as if created in the centre of the archipelago and thence dispersed only to a certain distance.
propositions.quote: It would appear as if it had been created in the centre of the archipelago, and thence had been dispersed only to a certain distance

propositions.name: wildness_is_particular_instinct
propositions.statement: The wildness of birds toward man is a particular instinct directed against him and not general caution.
propositions.quote: the wildness of birds with regard to man, is a particular instinct directed against him

propositions.name: new_beast_of_prey_havoc
propositions.statement: Introduction of a new beast of prey must cause havoc before the instincts of indigenous inhabitants become adapted to it.
propositions.quote: what havoc the introduction of any new beast of prey must cause in a country, before the instincts of the indigenous inhabitants have become adapted to the stranger's craft or power

propositions.name: perfect_gradation_of_beaks
propositions.statement: There is a perfect gradation in the size of the beaks in the different species of Geospiza.
propositions.quote: the perfect gradation in the size of the beaks in the different species of Geospiza

propositions.name: coloring_not_from_heat_or_light
propositions.statement: The usual gaudy colouring of intertropical productions is not related to the heat or light of those zones but perhaps to conditions of existence being generally favourable to life.
propositions.quote: the usual gaudy colouring of the intertropical productions, is not related either to the heat or light of those zones, but to some other cause, perhaps to the conditions of exbtence being generally favourable to life

propositions.name: secondary_epochs_lizards_swarmed
propositions.statement: In the Secondary epochs herbivorous and carnivorous lizards of great dimensions swarmed on land and in the sea.
propositions.quote: The geologist on hearing this will probably refer back in his mind to the Secondary epochs, when lizards, some herbivorous, some carnivorous, and of dimensions comparable only with our existing whales

propositions.name: species_versus_race_distinction
propositions.statement: Some closely allied forms would be ranked only as well-marked races or varieties while others, like Mimus trifasciatus, are very distinct species.
propositions.quote: These two latter species are closely allied, and would by some ornithologists be considered as only well-marked races or varieties; but the Mimus trifasciatus is very distinct

propositions.name: archipelago_distinct_botanical_province
propositions.statement: The proportion of new flowering plants is sufficient to make the archipelago a distinct botanical province.
propositions.quote: The proportion of 100 flowering plants out of 185 (or 175 excluding the imported weeds) being new, is sufficient, I conceive, to make the Galapagos Archipelago a distinct botanical province

propositions.name: satellites_organically_distinct
propositions.statement: The islands form a group of satellites physically similar yet organically distinct, though intimately related to each other and to America.
propositions.quote: a group of satellites, physically similar, organically distinct, yet intimately related to each other, and all related in a marked, though much lesser degree, to the great American continent

propositions.name: amblyrhynchus_confined_to_archipelago
propositions.statement: The remarkable genus of lizards Amblyrhynchus is confined to this archipelago.
propositions.quote: The Amblyrhynchus, a remarkable genus of lizards, is confined to this archipelago
